# netbox_custom_links (Data Source)

Lists custom_link objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_custom_links" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-custom_link" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: enabled, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner_id, owner_id__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `custom_links` (Attributes List) The matching custom_links. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_links))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--custom_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_links`

Read-Only:

- `button_class` (String) Button style. One of: default, blue, indigo, purple, pink, red, orange, yellow, green, teal, cyan, gray, black, white, ghost-dark.
- `created` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the link is rendered.
- `group_name` (String) Links with the same group name are rendered as a dropdown.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `link_text` (String) Jinja2 template for the link text; the object is available as {{ object }}.
- `link_url` (String) Jinja2 template for the link URL; the object is available as {{ object }}.
- `name` (String)
- `new_window` (Boolean) Open the link in a new browser window.
- `object_types` (Set of String) Object types the link is shown on, as app-labelled content types (dcim.device).
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `url` (String)
- `weight` (Number) Order within the group.
